title: Strategies against loneliness in Schleswig-Holstein
summary: Loneliness is particularly widespread amongst older people and represents a growing health and social challenge. The aim of the study is to continuously record, monitor and analyse changes over several years in relation to loneliness and other health and social issues amongst people aged 60 and over in Schleswig-Holstein. A total of 6,320 participants have already been recruited for the cohort study. Participants are asked to complete a questionnaire on topics relating to quality of life and general health.

interventions.name: An ongoing survey on loneliness and other health and social issues, such as low mood, social support, general state of health and a sense of coherence. People aged between 60 and 70 are surveyed again every two years.
